modalities.evidence: RIDER Neuro MRI contains imaging data

output.population: 19 patients with recurrent glioblastoma who underwent repeat imaging sets, 17 of whom also had repeat DTI
output.summary: Repeat brain MRI of patients with recurrent glioblastoma scanned about two days apart, including dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI, T1 mapping, diffusion tensor imaging, and contrast-enhanced 3D FLASH sequences.
